topic: Precision measurements, characteristic of precision measuring instruments.
syllabus_extract: Precision measurements, characteristic of precision measuring instruments.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of precision instrument handling; Safety: Handle glass/metal parts gently; Supervision: Instructor monitors grip and alignment.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Engineering Metrology?
Name one common unit of length used in aviation engineering.
Why is precision critical in aircraft component manufacturing?

development.content:
Definition of Engineering Metrology
Importance of precision in aviation
Sources of measurement error
Role of standards in metrology
Difference between accuracy and precision

Characteristics of precision instruments
Sensitivity and resolution concepts
Stability and repeatability factors
Environmental effects on measurements
Calibration requirements for instruments

Selection criteria for precision tools
Maintenance and storage protocols
Common defects in measuring instruments
Troubleshooting measurement discrepancies
Documentation of calibration records

summary_questions: Explain the difference between accuracy and precision in your own words.
List three environmental factors that affect precision measurements.
Why is regular calibration essential for precision instruments?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the importance of Engineering Metrology in the context of the next lesson on Vernier instruments (LP 04).

pft_rows.syllabus: Vernier instruments, reading of Vernier scale, types of Vernier Caliper, precautions while using the instrument.
